{{- /* The folded members of an API reference symbol, in the order its page shows them, in HTML (api-member-sections.html, the table of contents) and in Markdown (reference/single.markdown.md): properties, then events, methods, the rest; by title within each. Expects: the symbol's page. Returns a slice of member pages, empty for any other page. */ -}} {{- $members := slice -}} {{- if and .IsPage .CurrentSection -}} {{- with index (partialCached "api-members-by-parent.html" .CurrentSection .CurrentSection.Path) .Slug -}} {{- $all := . -}} {{- $kinds := slice "property" "event" "method" -}} {{- range $kinds -}} {{- range sort (where $all "Params.kind" .) "Title" -}} {{- $members = $members | append . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- range sort $all "Title" -}} {{- if not (in $kinds .Params.kind) }}{{ $members = $members | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $members -}}
